summary: Full pre-launch regression pass for FriendPlace marketing site + Mission Control CMS + shared FastAPI backend. Coverage: (1) Concierge onboarding via /site — hero pill opens overlay, no butterfly inside modal card, George/Georgia buttons route to /meet WITHOUT ?from=concierge, dialogue lines all render (Hello / I’m George / I’m really pleased you found us / Come in… let me show you around), CTA 'Come on, let me show you around.' visible; (2) /admin login — wrong password shows clear error and stays on /admin/login, correct password lands on /admin/bridge, session persists across page reload; (3) /admin/emails Studio — sidebar label reads 'Email templates', Sending Health panel with per-check breakdown (Resend API key ✓, Sending domain friendplace.com.au ✓, DKIM ✓, SPF ✓, DMARC ⚠, Most recent test send Delivered + View link) shows overall '🟠 Needs Attention'; all 5 templates listed (Welcome/Waitlist/Invitation/Password reset/Support ack); Personal templates show 'Signed by George/Georgia' toggle, Operational ones don’t; Subject + Preheader editable; desktop 720w + mobile 375w previews render server-side side-by-side; (4) Send Test button fired, 'Sending…' → message_id returned → status polled from 'sent' → 'delivered' in ~6s, 'View in Resend' link present; (5) George KB retrieval on top command bar — 'Where are the email templates?', bare-noun 'email templates', 'How do I send a test email?', 'Can I change the Welcome email?' all correctly cite the Email Templates Studio at Mission Control → Website → Email templates. 'Where’s the Bridge?' answers from KB. Weather Q refused politely. NO [KB-XXX] citations leaked into any reply. (6) Backend REST — login OK, /api/cms/email-previews returns 5 templates, /api/cms/email-previews/domains returns friendplace.com.au verified, /api/cms/email-previews/sending-health returns valid JSON, /api/cms/email-previews/welcome/render returns 57k HTML, /api/cms/email-previews/welcome/send → message_id → status polling reached 'delivered' in 6s. All 8 public marketing pages return 200 (/site /meet /about /how-it-works /features /faqs /register-interest /list-your-event). No 401/500 loop found. Overall: NO CRITICAL BUGS. A few Recommended and Nice-to-have polish items documented below.

minor.issue: DMARC record missing on friendplace.com.au — aggregator reports overall 'Needs Attention'. Not a bug in the code, but a pre-launch DNS item Garry should fix before public send.

ui_bugs.issue: JWT admin token is passed as a query parameter (?token=<jwt>) on the sandboxed iframe URL that renders /api/cms/email-previews/welcome.html. This is a Recommended-priority security concern: JWTs in URLs are logged in browser history, server access logs, and Referer headers, and can leak via clipboard copy. Prefer Authorization header via a cookie the API accepts, or a short-lived one-shot preview token distinct from the session JWT.

React console warning: 'Removing borderColor … when a conflicting property is set …'. Mixing shorthand `border` with longhand `borderColor` during rerender. Not user-visible but pollutes console — fix by consolidating to either all longhand or all shorthand.

The Sending Health panel does not render a literal 'Sending Health' section title — only the status pill ('🟠 Needs Attention') + 'Sending to hello@friendplace.com.au' subheader. Spec (Garry) calls for a labelled panel; recommend adding a small SECTION-caps 'SENDING HEALTH' header for clarity.

integration_issues.issue: In headless Playwright, clicking 'Come on, let me show you around.' set state to 'leading' and the dialogue faded, but the URL did NOT change to /about within a 10s window. Prior iteration 125 verified this visually so likely a headless-browser / event-timing quirk rather than a code regression. Main agent should manually smoke-test in a real browser to confirm; if it reproduces there, inspect LeadingButterfly.tsx onLead listener firing.

issues: Sandbox is set without allow-scripts (correct security posture); accompanying browser message 'Blocked script execution' clutters console — consider adding a comment or explicitly sanitising the preview HTML to remove any <script> so the warning stops firing every render.

action_items: [Recommended] Stop passing JWT via ?token= in iframe preview URL. Use a same-origin cookie set at login (SameSite=Lax, HttpOnly, Secure) that /api/cms/email-previews/{name}.html accepts, OR issue a short-lived one-shot preview JWT distinct from the session token.
[Recommended] Add DMARC TXT record for friendplace.com.au before public launch — pre-launch email hygiene requirement (Sending Health is currently orange 'Needs Attention' purely on this).
[Nice-to-have] Fix MorningBriefing.tsx:49 border/borderColor mixed-style React warning.
[Nice-to-have] Consider adding a KB entry for 'George’s Workspace' — sidebar item exists but George replied 'I don’t have a documented answer' when asked. Users familiar with the sidebar will ask.
[Nice-to-have] Add a small 'SENDING HEALTH' section header above the status panel on /admin/emails to match the Garry spec wording.

[Nice-to-have] Manually verify Flight #2 (Meet → About) in a real browser. Automated Playwright run didn’t observe the URL change to /about after CTA click within 10s — code path looks correct so likely a headless quirk, but a quick manual smoke is worth doing before launch.

[Nice-to-have] Suppress the 'Blocked script execution' console warning fired by the sandboxed preview iframe (harmless but noisy). Strip <script> tags from the preview HTML server-side before response, or set sandbox='' explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: email-previews token-in-URL is the highest-priority finding here. All other observations are polish.

Concierge choreography (SiteHeader → ConciergeOverlay → /meet dialogue → LeadingButterfly) uses well-scoped CustomEvents ('friendplace:meet-george', 'friendplace:lead-to-tour') and a single portal-mounted flyer. No sign of dual butterflies at any point in the observed flow.

KB retrieval via services/george/chat.py correctly strips [KB-XXX] tags before streaming to the client — spot-checked five queries, no leakage. Bare-noun 'email templates' triggers the KB lookup as designed.
Sending Health aggregator returns a well-shaped envelope with 6 checks + overall status + recipient + resend_configured flag. Great UX-ready shape.
Session persistence: refreshing /admin/emails after login keeps the session (localStorage-backed JWT + AdminShell re-hydrates it on mount). Good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all endpoints tested: login, sending-health, domains, templates list, render, send, message status, launch-status, plus 8 public pages 200 OK)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (concierge/meet/emails/chat all pass; Flight #2 URL change not observed in headless run — needs manual smoke)

seed_data_creation: None. One test email sent to hello@friendplace.com.au (delivered; message_id 0ba62e51-a329-4e28-ba54-fdf60974f6d1 in Resend dashboard). Login rate-limit unaffected — only one wrong-password attempt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression pass complete. For any re-verification: (a) marketing site is nginx-routed at /site,/meet,/about,/how-it-works,/features,/faqs,/register-interest,/list-your-event; (b) admin at /admin/login — hello@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!; (c) George chat SSE at POST /api/cms + /api/george/chat with CMS bearer token, streams event: delta/plan/tools/kb_proposal/done; (d) email preview endpoints all live under /api/cms/email-previews — NOT /api/cms/email-previews/templates (that returned 404 during exploration).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no reproducible critical bugs. Highest-priority action item is a security-hardening one (JWT in URL) rather than a regression.
